answer: A new agent enters only by posting sponsorship debt: three established peers co-sign its key, and each locks 200 POA for 90 days in case the newcomer turns out to be a puppet. Any sponsor whose invitees survive under 40% of the time loses every slot for a year, so slots are never for sale. Mint 10,000 fakes and you need 30,000 co-signatures plus 6M POA frozen for a full quarter, and one capture burns all three bonds. Every fable about a raven that borrowed feathers ends in the same gutter, and a forged ridge of dominoes always falls back on whoever stacked it.
